zh.name: 洗衣妇
zh.ability: 第一夜得知：两个玩家中有一人是某个镇民。
zh.player: 你会知道一个镇民身份，并看到两个玩家；这两人里至少有一个真的是这个镇民。
zh.quickAbility: 得知两名玩家中有一人是某个镇民

en.name: Washerwoman
en.ability: On your first night, you learn that 1 of 2 players is a particular Townsfolk.
en.player: You learn a Townsfolk character and see two players. At least one of them really is that character.
en.quickAbility: Learn that 1 of 2 players is a particular Townsfolk

zh.name: 图书管理员
zh.ability: 第一夜得知：两个玩家中有一人是某个外来者；若没有外来者，可得知 0。
zh.player: 你会知道一个外来者身份，并看到两个玩家；这两人里至少有一个是这个外来者。也可能被告知本局没有外来者。
zh.quickAbility: 得知两名玩家中有一人是某个外来者，或得知没有外来者

en.name: Librarian
en.ability: On your first night, you learn that 1 of 2 players is a particular Outsider, or that there are no Outsiders in play.
en.player: You learn an Outsider character and see two players. At least one is that character, unless you are shown a zero.
en.quickAbility: Learn that 1 of 2 players is a particular Outsider, or that none are in play

zh.name: 调查员
zh.ability: 第一夜得知：两个玩家中有一人是某个爪牙。
zh.player: 你会知道一个爪牙身份，并看到两个玩家；这两人里至少有一个是这个爪牙。但有些角色可能被错误登记。
zh.quickAbility: 得知两名玩家中有一人是某个爪牙

en.name: Investigator
en.ability: On your first night, you learn that 1 of 2 players is a particular Minion.
en.player: You learn a Minion character and see two players. Normally at least one is that Minion, although registration effects can interfere.
en.quickAbility: Learn that 1 of 2 players is a particular Minion

zh.name: 厨师
zh.ability: 第一夜得知有几对相邻的邪恶玩家。
zh.player: 你得到一个数字：有多少对坐在相邻位置的邪恶玩家。首尾也算相邻。
zh.quickAbility: 得知有几对邪恶玩家相邻而坐

en.name: Chef
en.ability: On your first night, you learn how many pairs of evil players are sitting next to each other.
en.player: You receive a number counting adjacent evil pairs. The first and last seats are also adjacent.
en.quickAbility: Learn how many pairs of evil players are sitting next to each other

zh.name: 共情者
zh.ability: 每晚得知自己两个存活邻居中有几个邪恶玩家。
zh.player: 每晚你会得到 0、1 或 2，表示你左右最近的两个存活邻居里有几个邪恶玩家。死人会被跳过。
zh.quickAbility: 得知两个存活邻居中有几个邪恶玩家

en.name: Empath
en.ability: Each night, you learn how many of your two nearest living neighbours are evil.
en.player: You receive 0, 1, or 2. Dead players are skipped when finding your nearest living neighbours.
en.quickAbility: Learn how many of your 2 living neighbours are evil

zh.name: 占卜师
zh.ability: 每晚选择两名玩家，得知其中是否有恶魔。另有一名好人红鲱鱼也会被算作恶魔。
zh.player: 每晚选两人，问“这里面有没有恶魔”。注意：有一名好人会被你误判成恶魔。
zh.quickAbility: 选择两名玩家，得知其中是否有恶魔；但有一名好人会误报

en.name: Fortune Teller
en.ability: Each night, choose 2 players and learn whether either is a Demon. One good Red Herring also registers as a Demon to you.
en.player: Choose two players and ask whether a Demon is among them. Remember that one good player will also produce a yes.
en.quickAbility: Choose 2 players and learn if either is the Demon; 1 good player may register falsely

undertaker.icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path class="softFill" d="M8.2 7.1h7.6l1.7 2v8.2H6.5V9.1Z"/><path d="M8.2 7.1h7.6l1.7 2v8.2H6.5V9.1Z"/><path d="M8.1 17.3h7.8M12 9.1v5.4M9.8 11.3h4.4"/></svg>

zh.name: 送葬者
zh.ability: 每晚得知今天被处决玩家的角色。
zh.player: 晚上你会得知白天被处决玩家的身份。没人被处决时通常没有信息。
zh.quickAbility: 得知今天被处决的玩家是什么角色

en.name: Undertaker
en.ability: Each night, you learn the character of the player executed today.
en.player: You learn who the executed player really was. If nobody was executed, you usually receive no information.
en.quickAbility: Learn the character of the player executed today

zh.name: 僧侣
zh.ability: 每晚选择除自己外一名玩家，保护其免受恶魔攻击。
zh.player: 每晚选一名其他玩家。如果恶魔今晚杀他，他不会因此死亡。不能保护自己。
zh.quickAbility: 选择一名其他玩家，使其今晚免受恶魔伤害

en.name: Monk
en.ability: Each night, choose another player. They are safe from the Demon tonight.
en.player: Protect one other player each night. You cannot protect yourself, and the protection does not stop every possible cause of death.
en.quickAbility: Choose another player; they are safe from the Demon tonight

zh.name: 守鸦人
zh.ability: 若夜里死亡，当晚醒来选择一名玩家并得知其角色。
zh.player: 如果你在夜里死亡，你会立刻醒来查一个人的真实身份。白天被处决不会触发。
zh.quickAbility: 选择一名玩家并得知其角色

en.name: Ravenkeeper
en.ability: If you die at night, choose a player and learn their character.
en.player: Your ability triggers only when you die at night, not when you are executed during the day.
en.quickAbility: Choose a player and learn their character

zh.name: 圣女
zh.ability: 第一次被镇民提名时，该镇民立即被处决。
zh.player: 第一次有镇民提名你时，那个镇民会立刻被处决。只有第一次，而且提名者必须是镇民。
zh.quickAbility: 若首次提名者是镇民，该镇民立即被处决

en.name: Virgin
en.ability: The first time a Townsfolk nominates you, that Townsfolk is executed immediately.
en.player: This can happen only once, and only when the nominator is a Townsfolk.
en.quickAbility: If first nominated by a Townsfolk, that Townsfolk is executed immediately

slayer.icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle class="softFill" cx="12" cy="12" r="5.7"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="5.7"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="2.2"/><path d="M12 4.4v2.2M12 17.4v2.2M4.4 12h2.2M17.4 12h2.2"/></svg>

zh.name: 杀手
zh.ability: 白天一次性公开选择一人；若目标是恶魔，目标死亡。
zh.player: 白天你有一次开枪机会。公开选择一人；如果他是恶魔，他会死亡，否则通常无事发生。
zh.quickAbility: 全场仅一次，公开选择一人，若目标是恶魔，目标死亡，否则无事发生

en.name: Slayer
en.ability: Once per game during the day, publicly choose a player. If they are the Demon, they die.
en.player: You get one public shot. If your target is not the Demon, usually nothing happens and the ability is spent.
en.quickAbility: Once per game, publicly choose a player; if they are the Demon, they die, otherwise nothing happens

zh.name: 士兵
zh.ability: 不会被恶魔杀死。
zh.player: 恶魔夜里杀你时，你不会因此死亡。其他死亡方式仍可能发生。
zh.quickAbility: 恶魔不能杀死你

en.name: Soldier
en.ability: You are safe from the Demon.
en.player: A Demon attack cannot kill you, although execution and other causes of death still can.
en.quickAbility: The Demon cannot kill you

zh.name: 市长
zh.ability: 若只剩 3 名存活玩家且无人被处决，好人获胜。若夜晚被攻击，可能由其他玩家代死。
zh.player: 只剩 3 个活人时，如果白天没人被处决，好人胜利。你夜里被攻击时，可能会弹到别人身上。
zh.quickAbility: 若只剩3人且白天无人被处决，则好人获胜；夜晚死亡可能转移

en.name: Mayor
en.ability: If only 3 players live and nobody is executed, good wins. If you are attacked at night, another player might die instead.
en.player: At three alive, a day with no execution can win the game for good. A night attack on you may be redirected.
en.quickAbility: With 3 alive, no execution means good wins; your night death may be redirected

zh.name: 管家
zh.ability: 每晚选择主人；白天只有主人正在投票或已经被计票，管家才可以投票。
zh.player: 每晚选一个主人。第二天投票时，观察主人是否举手或已经被计票；如果主人不投或放下手，你也要放下手。这个限制主要靠管家自己遵守，不是说书人公开管控。你仍然可以提名。
zh.quickAbility: 选择一名主人，明天只有主人投票时你才可以投票

en.name: Butler
en.ability: Each night, choose a master. Tomorrow, you may vote only if your master is voting or their vote has already been counted.
en.player: Watch your master during each vote and follow the restriction yourself. You may still nominate.
en.quickAbility: Choose a master; tomorrow you may vote only when your master votes

zh.name: 钟表匠
zh.ability: 第一夜得知：恶魔到最近爪牙相隔几步。
zh.player: 你会得到一个数字。距离从恶魔旁边的玩家开始数；如果爪牙正好坐在恶魔旁边，数字就是 1。
zh.quickAbility: 第一夜得知：恶魔到最近爪牙相隔几步。

en.name: Clockmaker
en.ability: On your first night, learn the number of steps from the Demon to the nearest Minion.
en.player: A Minion sitting next to the Demon gives a result of 1.
en.quickAbility: On your first night, learn the number of steps from the Demon to the nearest Minion.

zh.name: 侍女
zh.ability: 选两名其他存活玩家，得知其中几人今晚因自身能力醒来。
zh.player: 每晚选择两名其他存活玩家，你会得到 0、1 或 2。只计算他们今晚因自身角色能力而醒来的情况。
zh.quickAbility: 选两名其他存活玩家，得知其中几人今晚因自身能力醒来

en.name: Chambermaid
en.ability: Each night, choose 2 living players other than yourself and learn how many woke tonight because of their own ability.
en.player: You receive 0, 1, or 2, but do not learn which chosen player woke.
en.quickAbility: Choose 2 other living players and learn how many woke tonight due to their own ability

zh.name: 赌徒
zh.ability: 除首夜外，每晚选择一人并猜其角色；如果猜错，你会死亡。
zh.player: 每晚选择一名玩家并猜他的具体角色。猜对通常无事发生；猜错时你会死亡，因此你的生死本身也能形成信息。
zh.quickAbility: 选择一人并猜其角色；如果猜错，你会死亡

en.name: Gambler
en.ability: Each night*, choose a player and guess their character. If you are wrong, you die.
en.player: Guess one player’s exact character. A wrong guess can kill you, so whether you survive can itself become information.
en.quickAbility: Choose a player and guess their character; if wrong, you die

zh.name: 弄臣
zh.ability: 第一次将要死亡时不会死亡。
zh.player: 第一次有事情会让你死亡时，你不会死亡；之后再次受到致死效果时就可能正常死亡。
zh.quickAbility: 第一次将要死亡时不会死亡

en.name: Fool
en.ability: The first time you would die, you do not.
en.player: The first effect that would kill you fails to do so. Later lethal effects can kill you normally.
en.quickAbility: The first time you would die, you do not

zh.name: 神谕者
zh.ability: 得知死亡玩家中有几名邪恶玩家。
zh.player: 每晚得知当前所有死亡玩家中有几名邪恶玩家。随着死亡人数增加，这个数字可以帮助你判断已死玩家的阵营。
zh.quickAbility: 得知死亡玩家中有几名邪恶玩家

en.name: Oracle
en.ability: Each night*, learn how many dead players are evil.
en.player: Each night you learn the total number of evil players among everyone who is currently dead.
en.quickAbility: Learn how many dead players are evil

zh.name: 艺术家
zh.ability: 每局一次，白天私下向说书人询问任意一个是非问题。
zh.player: 你可以找说书人私聊，问一个能用“是/否”回答的问题。问题越清楚，得到的信息越好用。
zh.quickAbility: 每局一次，白天私下向说书人询问任意一个是非问题。

en.name: Artist
en.ability: Once per game during the day, privately ask the Storyteller any yes/no question.
en.player: Ask one clear question that can be answered yes or no. Clearer questions produce more useful information.
en.quickAbility: Once per game during the day, privately ask the Storyteller any yes/no question.

zh.name: 贤者
zh.ability: 如果被恶魔杀死，你会得知恶魔是两名玩家之一。
zh.player: 活着时没有信息。只有被恶魔杀死才触发；白天被处决或被其他来源杀死通常不会触发。
zh.quickAbility: 如果被恶魔杀死，你会得知恶魔是两名玩家之一。

en.name: Sage
en.ability: If the Demon kills you, you learn that the Demon is 1 of 2 players.
en.player: You receive information only when the Demon kills you, not when you are executed or die from another source.
en.quickAbility: If the Demon kills you, you learn that the Demon is 1 of 2 players.

zh.name: 酒鬼
zh.ability: 你不知道自己是酒鬼，会以为自己是某个镇民；你的能力没有效果。
zh.player: 你不会知道自己是酒鬼。你会以为自己是某个镇民，但你的能力没有效果，得到的信息也可能不可靠。
zh.quickAbility: 你以为自己是镇民，但其实不是

en.name: Drunk
en.ability: You do not know you are the Drunk. You think you are a Townsfolk, but your ability does not work.
en.player: You are shown a Townsfolk character. Your information may be true or false, but your supposed ability has no effect.
en.quickAbility: You think you are a Townsfolk, but you are not

zh.name: 呆瓜
zh.ability: 当你得知自己死亡时，公开选择一名存活玩家；若对方邪恶，你的阵营失败。
zh.player: 你死亡后要公开选一名还活着的玩家。选到好人通常没事；选到邪恶玩家，好人立刻输。
zh.quickAbility: 当你得知自己死亡时，公开选择一名存活玩家；若对方邪恶，你的阵营失败。

en.name: Klutz
en.ability: When you learn that you died, publicly choose a living player. If they are evil, your team loses.
en.player: You must choose a living player after learning you died. Choosing evil immediately loses the game for your team.
en.quickAbility: When you learn that you died, publicly choose a living player. If they are evil, your team loses.

zh.name: 隐士
zh.ability: 可能被登记为邪恶、爪牙或恶魔，即使死亡也可能如此。
zh.player: 你是好人，但别人的侦测能力可能把你看成邪恶、爪牙或恶魔。死亡后也可能这样。
zh.quickAbility: 你可能被判定为邪恶、爪牙或恶魔

en.name: Recluse
en.ability: You might register as evil, a Minion, or a Demon, even while dead.
en.player: You are good, but detection abilities may see you as an evil character.
en.quickAbility: You may register as evil, a Minion, or a Demon

zh.name: 圣徒
zh.ability: 如果你被处决，邪恶阵营获胜。
zh.player: 如果你白天被处决，邪恶阵营立刻获胜。夜里被杀不触发。
zh.quickAbility: 如果你被处决，邪恶阵营立即获胜

en.name: Saint
en.ability: If you are executed, your team loses.
en.player: Execution causes evil to win immediately. Dying at night does not trigger this ability.
en.quickAbility: If you are executed, evil wins immediately

zh.name: 月之子
zh.ability: 死亡后，公开选择一名存活玩家；若其是好人，该玩家今晚死亡。
zh.player: 当你得知自己死亡后，要公开选择一名仍存活的玩家。如果你选中好人，那名玩家会在当晚死亡；选中邪恶玩家则不会因此死亡。
zh.quickAbility: 公开选一名存活玩家；若其是好人，该玩家今晚死亡

en.name: Moonchild
en.ability: When you learn that you died, publicly choose a living player. If they are good, they die tonight.
en.player: After your death, publicly choose a living player. Choosing good causes that player to die that night; choosing evil does not.
en.quickAbility: Publicly choose a living player; if good, they die tonight

zh.name: 投毒者
zh.ability: 每晚选择一名玩家：该玩家今晚和明天白天中毒。
zh.player: 每晚选一人中毒。他的能力暂时无效，得到的信息可能是错的。
zh.quickAbility: 选择一名玩家，使其今晚和明天白天中毒

en.name: Poisoner
en.ability: Each night, choose a player. They are poisoned tonight and tomorrow day.
en.player: The chosen player’s ability does not work temporarily, and their information may be wrong.
en.quickAbility: Choose a player; they are poisoned tonight and tomorrow day

zh.name: 间谍
zh.ability: 每晚可以查看魔典；可能被登记为好人或镇民。
zh.player: 每晚可以看说书人的魔典。别人查你时，你可能显示成好人或镇民。
zh.quickAbility: 查看说书人的真实信息；自己可能被判定为好人或镇民

en.name: Spy
en.ability: Each night, you may see the Grimoire. You might register as good or as a Townsfolk.
en.player: You can inspect the Storyteller’s information each night and may look good to detection abilities.
en.quickAbility: View the Grimoire; you may register as good or as a Townsfolk

zh.name: 猩红女巫
zh.ability: 若恶魔在仍有至少 5 名玩家存活时死亡，你变成恶魔。
zh.player: 如果恶魔死亡时仍有至少 5 名玩家存活，你会变成新的恶魔，游戏继续。
zh.quickAbility: 若至少5名玩家存活且恶魔死亡，你变成新的恶魔

en.name: Scarlet Woman
en.ability: If the Demon dies while 5 or more players are alive, you become the Demon.
en.player: When the condition is met, you become the new Imp and the game continues.
en.quickAbility: If the Demon dies with 5 or more players alive, you become the Demon

zh.name: 男爵
zh.ability: 本局多 2 个外来者，少 2 个镇民。
zh.player: 你的存在会改变开局配置：多 2 个外来者，少 2 个镇民。你白天主要靠发言帮助邪恶阵营。
zh.quickAbility: 本局多2个外来者，少2个镇民

en.name: Baron
en.ability: There are 2 extra Outsiders and 2 fewer Townsfolk in play.
en.player: Your ability changes the setup before play begins. You have no night action.
en.quickAbility: This game has 2 extra Outsiders and 2 fewer Townsfolk

zh.name: 魔鬼代言人
zh.ability: 选一名存活玩家，不能连续选同一人；其明天被处决时不死。
zh.player: 每晚保护一名存活玩家免于第二天的处决死亡，但不能连续两晚选择同一个人。你可以保护邪恶队友，也可以故意保护好人制造混乱。
zh.quickAbility: 选一名存活玩家，不能连续选同一人；其明天被处决时不死

en.name: Devil's Advocate
en.ability: Each night, choose a living player, different from last night. If executed tomorrow, they do not die.
en.player: Protect one living player from dying by execution the next day. You cannot choose the same player on consecutive nights.
en.quickAbility: Choose a living player, not the same as last night; if executed tomorrow, they do not die

zh.name: 小恶魔
zh.ability: 每晚选择一名玩家死亡。若自杀，另一名爪牙变成小恶魔。
zh.player: 每晚杀一人。你也可以选择杀自己，通常会让一名爪牙变成新的小恶魔。第一夜通常不杀人。
zh.quickAbility: 选择一名玩家死亡；若选择自己，一名爪牙变成小恶魔

en.name: Imp
en.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If you kill yourself, a Minion becomes the Imp.
en.player: Kill one player each night. You may choose yourself to pass the Demon role to a Minion. The first night normally has no kill.
en.quickAbility: Choose a player to die; if you choose yourself, a Minion becomes the Imp

zh.name: 普卡
zh.ability: 选一人使其中毒；此前被你中毒的人恢复健康并死亡。
zh.player: 每晚选择一名玩家让他中毒。你上一次中毒的目标会先恢复健康，然后死亡，因此你的击杀通常比选择目标晚一个夜晚发生。
zh.quickAbility: 选一人使其中毒；此前被你中毒的人恢复健康并死亡

en.name: Pukka
en.ability: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned. The previously poisoned player becomes healthy, then dies.
en.player: Your new target is poisoned first; the previous target recovers and then dies, creating a delayed kill pattern.
en.quickAbility: Choose a player to poison; the previously poisoned player becomes healthy and dies

zh.name: 祖母
zh.ability: 得知一名好人及其角色；他被恶魔杀死时，你也死亡。
zh.player: 得知一名好人及其角色；他被恶魔杀死时，你也死亡。
zh.quickAbility: 得知一名好人及其角色；他被恶魔杀死时，你也死亡

en.name: Grandmother
en.ability: Learn a good player and their character; if the Demon kills them, you die too.
en.player: Learn a good player and their character; if the Demon kills them, you die too.
en.quickAbility: Learn a good player and their character; if the Demon kills them, you die too.

zh.name: 水手
zh.ability: 选择一名存活玩家；你或他醉酒至明天黄昏。清醒的你不会死亡。
zh.player: 选择一名存活玩家；你或他醉酒至明天黄昏。清醒的你不会死亡。
zh.quickAbility: 选择一名存活玩家；你或他醉酒至明天黄昏。清醒的你不会死亡

en.name: Sailor
